title: Vertebral Axial Decompression (VAX-D)
item_service_description: <p> Vertebral axial decompression is performed for symptomatic relief of pain associated with lumbar disk problems. The treatment combines pelvic and/or cervical traction connected to a special table that permits the traction application.</p>
indications_limitations: <p> There is insufficient scientific data to support the benefits of this technique. Therefore, VAX-D is not covered by Medicare.</p>
revision_history: 3/1997 -&#160;Provided that VAX-D not covered by Medicare. Effective date 4/15/1997. (TN 93)
